review.why: Chooses how to make marketing images (generate, design tool, screenshot) and covers sizes, prompting, optimization and social preview images.
review.summary: Compares AI image models, design tools, screenshots with overlays and stock photos, with a decision tree on text, consistency, editing and cost. It gives a prompt formula, workflows for blog heroes, social graphics, product mockups and banners with size tables, an optimization checklist with conversion commands, preview-image tags and a list of common mistakes.
strengths: Warns against AI-generated product screenshots because models invent interfaces
Platform size tables for social, banners and store listings
Practical optimization checklist: format, resize, compress, lazy load
cautions: Model names, prices and retirement dates change quickly
Prompting detail per model is in a file not read here
